_doc: Yahoo Finance sector/industry -> Indonesian sector label close to the IDX-IC classification.
Lookup order in engine/sectors.py: overrides[ticker] -> industries[Yahoo industry] -> sectors[Yahoo sector] -> 'Lainnya'.
Communication Services is split by industry the way IDX-IC does it: telecom -> Infrastruktur,
internet platforms -> Teknologi, media & entertainment -> Konsumen Non-Primer. Any other
Communication Services industry falls back to Infrastruktur (telecom dominates this sector on IDX).
Utilities and heavy construction are Infrastruktur; transport industries of Yahoo 'Industrials' are
Transportasi & Logistik; coal is always Energi (Yahoo files coking coal under Basic Materials).
Add a ticker to 'overrides' (normalized, e.g. BBCA.JK) when Yahoo labels it oddly or not at all.
